text:
Ava (CSM): Quick heads-up — Preview Cohort 7 enrollment triage. We offered 28 seats; 19 accepted, 12 have completed provisioning. 5 marked as no-show for the kickoff, 3 are blocked on SSO/RBAC. Concerned about activation curve and renewal signals if we don’t get enablement momentum. Can we triage status and assign owners?

Diego (Success Eng): Thanks. Can you drop the list of the 3 SSO blockers? I can take one.

Ava (CSM): Sure — Priya from Acme, Marcus (internal alias: marcus-fin), and @unnamed (they submitted a ticket). Links: https://redwood-internal.docs/preview-cohort7/roster (view-only).

Priya (Acme Corp): FYI — we saw the provisioning email but our security team needs SAML attributes mapped (email vs userid). I can join a quick call tomorrow.

Ivy (Onboarding): I’ll run a focused 30-min SSO troubleshooting session. Diego — can you bring the mapping snippet and the quick test command?

Diego (Success Eng): Yep. Snippet: ```saml: { nameid: email, attributes: [email, groups, department] }``` Also test with `curl -X POST https://preview.redwood.ai/sso/test -d @saml-payload.json` — works locally.

Ava (CSM): Great — Ivy, can you own the call scheduling? Priority to Acme (Priya) and Marcus. If we resolve SSO this week, it should push activation for 2 seats.

Ivy (Onboarding): Scheduling now. Proposing: Tue 10:30am PT or Wed 2pm PT. Sending calendar invites.

ops-bot: calendar invite created: Preview-Co7-SSO-triage — Tue 10:30am PT — attendees: Priya (Acme Corp), Ivy, Diego, Ava. (ics: https://calendar.redwood/evt/abc123)

Priya (Acme Corp): Tue 10:30 works. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Ava (CSM): Separately — five no-shows: three had conflicts, two requested deferred onboarding. We're planning a re-engagement push: short product demo + recommended prompt recipes tailored to finance workflows. Diego — can you draft a one-pager of recommended prompts for review?

Diego (Success Eng): On it. Will post a draft in 2 hours in this thread.

Ava (CSM): Also flagging renewal risk indicator: accounts that don't hit 30% activation by week 3 go into low-touch outreach. We should decide if any from Cohort 7 need escalation to AE. Marcus is borderline; he’s a heavy user if we unblock SSO.

Ivy (Onboarding): I'll add a tag `needs-AE-check` for Marcus in the CRM if not activated by Friday.

Ava (CSM): For feedback capture — want to run a 1-question pulse after the first successful run: "Did Redwood reduce your time-to-answer for task X?" If yes/no freeform. Who can wire the pulse?

Diego (Success Eng): Can wire a one-question webhook to the in-app prompt flow. I’ll coordinate with Product to add the micro-survey.

Ava (CSM): Perfect. Action items recap:
- Ivy: run SSO triage call Tue 10:30 PT (invites sent)
- Diego: SSO mapping snippet + draft prompt one-pager (due today)
- Ivy: tag Marcus for AE check if no activation by Fri
- Diego + Product: add 1-question pulse after first success run
- Ava: follow up on re-engagement demo for no-shows

Ava (CSM): If anyone sees blocking capacity issues with Dedicated pools for the preview, call out immediately — we had one tokenized job queue spike last week and I don't want surprises during demos.

Diego (Success Eng): Noted. I’ll monitor the pool and set an alert for >60% sustained utilization during demo windows.

Priya (Acme Corp): Appreciate the responsiveness — excited to get SSO sorted and start testing.

Ava (CSM): Thanks team — loop back here once the prompt doc is posted and after the call. :thumbsup:
